title: Braces
what: An orthodontist glues small brackets to your teeth and joins them with a wire. The wire slowly moves the teeth into the right place.
why: For crooked teeth, a wrong bite, or gaps between teeth, in children and adults.
duration: putting them on usually takes 1 to 2 hours; treatment usually lasts 1.5 to 2.5 years
tell_doctor: If you wore braces or plates before

prepare.title: Exam
prepare.text: Usually first, X-rays of the teeth, molds or a scan are taken, and a treatment plan is made.

prepare.title: Dental treatment
prepare.text: Before braces go on, cavities must be treated and a professional cleaning done.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Eat before your visit. After the braces go on, your teeth may ache for the first few days.

bring: Your dental X-rays, if you had them
steps: Your teeth are cleaned and dried
Your lips and cheeks are held back with a special holder
Glue is put on the teeth and the brackets are placed
The glue is hardened with a special lamp
The wire is put into the brackets
The doctor shows you how to brush with braces
feel: It does not hurt, but keeping your mouth open for a long time is tiring
For the first 3 to 5 days, your teeth ache, especially when chewing
The brackets may rub your cheeks. Special orthodontic wax helps
after: For the first few days, soft food
During the whole treatment, avoid hard, sticky, and chewy food. Brackets can come off
Brush after every meal, using a small interdental brush
Orthodontist visits are usually every 4 to 8 weeks
After the braces come off, you wear a retainer so the teeth do not move back

faq.a: Your teeth ache for the first days and after each tightening. Usually it gets easy after a few days.

faq.q: How long do I wear braces?
faq.a: Usually from one and a half to two and a half years. The orthodontist will tell you exactly.
Yes. Teeth can move at any age if the gums and bone are healthy.
